indicator.subject: Science
indicator.content_standard: B4.4.3.2 (printed as B4.4.3.2; likely typo for B6.4.3.2) Recognise some simple machines used for making work easier, analyse their advantages and know their uses
indicator.objective: Identify levers, pulleys, inclined planes as classes of simple machines and cite some common examples

skills.description: Recognise that a simple machine is a device that makes work easier.
Identify a lever as a simple machine and give examples (e.g. scissors, wheelbarrow, crowbar, pliers).
Identify a pulley as a simple machine and give examples (e.g. flagpole, well bucket, crane).
Identify an inclined plane as a simple machine and give examples (e.g. ramp, slope, ladder).
Classify given tools as levers, pulleys, or inclined planes.
State the uses and advantages of simple machines (make work easier, reduce effort).

spec.difficultyPlan: 20 questions total — Difficulty 1: 5; Difficulty 2: 7; Difficulty 3: 5; Difficulty 4: 3.
misconceptions: A simple machine does not make work easier.
All simple machines are the same.

questions.stem: What is a simple machine?
options: A device that makes work easier
A device that makes work harder
A machine that only rich people use
hints: It helps us do work with less effort.
Think about a wheelbarrow or a ramp.
questions.explanation: A simple machine is a device that makes work easier by reducing the effort needed.
questions.misconception: A simple machine does not make work easier.

questions.stem: Which of these best describes a simple machine?
options: A tool that helps us do work with less effort
A machine that uses fuel to work
A machine that is very expensive
A machine that only works in factories
hints: Think about a ramp helping you push a load.
questions.explanation: A simple machine is a tool that helps us do work with less effort.

questions.stem: What is a simple machine?
answer: a device that makes work easier
a tool that helps do work with less effort
questions.explanation: A simple machine is a device that makes work easier.

questions.stem: Which of these is a lever?
hints: It has a pivot and two arms.
questions.explanation: A pair of scissors is a lever. It has a pivot and two arms that help cut.

questions.stem: Which of these tools is a lever?
hints: It has a handle and a wheel.
You use it to carry heavy loads.
questions.explanation: A wheelbarrow is a lever. It helps lift and carry heavy loads with less effort.

questions.stem: Name one example of a lever.
hints: Think about a tool with a pivot.
questions.explanation: Examples of levers include scissors, wheelbarrows, crowbars, pliers and seesaws.

questions.stem: Why is a crowbar considered a lever?
options: It has a pivot and helps lift heavy objects with less effort
It is a long stick with no pivot
It uses a rope and wheel
hints: A crowbar pivots on a point.
questions.explanation: A crowbar is a lever because it has a pivot point and helps lift heavy objects with less effort.
questions.misconception: A crowbar is not a lever.

questions.stem: Which of these is a pulley?
options: A flagpole with a rope and wheel
hints: It has a wheel and a rope.
questions.explanation: A flagpole with a rope and wheel is a pulley. It helps raise and lower the flag.

questions.stem: Name one example of a pulley.
hints: Think about how a flag is raised.
Think about a bucket in a well.
questions.explanation: Examples of pulleys include a flagpole, a well bucket and a crane.

questions.stem: What makes a crane a pulley?
options: It uses a wheel and rope to lift heavy loads
It uses a pivot and lever
hints: They use a wheel and rope.
questions.explanation: A crane is a pulley because it uses a wheel and rope to lift heavy loads with less effort.

questions.stem: Which of these is an inclined plane?
hints: It helps move things up or down.
questions.explanation: A ramp is an inclined plane. It is a slope that helps move things up or down with less effort.

questions.stem: Which of these is an inclined plane used in everyday life?
hints: You climb it to go up.
questions.explanation: A staircase is an inclined plane. It helps people move up to a higher level with less effort.

questions.stem: Name one example of an inclined plane.
questions.explanation: Examples of inclined planes include ramps, slopes, ladders and staircases.

questions.stem: Why is a ramp useful for loading a heavy drum onto a truck?
options: It reduces the effort needed to move the drum up
hints: A ramp is an inclined plane.
It helps move heavy loads with less effort.
questions.explanation: A ramp is useful because it reduces the effort needed to move a heavy drum up onto the truck.

questions.stem: Which classification is correct?
options: Ramp → inclined plane; scissors → lever; flagpole → pulley
Ramp → lever; scissors → pulley; flagpole → inclined plane
Ramp → pulley; scissors → inclined plane; flagpole → lever
Ramp → inclined plane; scissors → pulley; flagpole → lever
questions.explanation: A ramp is an inclined plane, scissors are a lever, and a flagpole is a pulley.
questions.misconception: All simple machines are the same.

questions.stem: Classify these tools as lever, pulley or inclined plane: wheelbarrow, flagpole, ramp.
answer: wheelbarrow - lever; flagpole - pulley; ramp - inclined plane
wheelbarrow: lever, flagpole: pulley, ramp: inclined plane
hints: Think about how each tool works.
Wheelbarrow has a pivot; flagpole has a wheel; ramp is a slope.
questions.explanation: Wheelbarrow is a lever, flagpole is a pulley, and ramp is an inclined plane.

questions.stem: A pupil lists four tools: ramp, crowbar, well bucket, staircase. Which classification is correct?
options: Inclined planes: ramp, staircase; Levers: crowbar; Pulleys: well bucket
Inclined planes: ramp, crowbar; Levers: staircase; Pulleys: well bucket
Inclined planes: well bucket; Levers: ramp, crowbar; Pulleys: staircase
Inclined planes: ramp; Levers: crowbar, staircase; Pulleys: well bucket
questions.explanation: Ramps and staircases are inclined planes. A crowbar is a lever. A well bucket uses a pulley.

questions.stem: What is the main advantage of using a simple machine?
options: It makes work easier by reducing effort
hints: Think about a wheelbarrow carrying a load.
questions.explanation: The main advantage of a simple machine is that it makes work easier by reducing the effort needed.

questions.stem: State one advantage of using a pulley.
answer: it makes lifting heavy loads easier
it reduces the effort needed to lift things
it helps raise loads with less effort
hints: Think about lifting a heavy bucket from a well.
questions.explanation: One advantage of a pulley is that it makes lifting heavy loads easier by reducing the effort needed.

questions.stem: In groups, design and make a simple machine of your choice (lever, pulley or inclined plane) using suitable materials such as bamboo, wood, cardboard, plastics, paper or straws. Present your model to the class and explain how it makes work easier.

Explained how the machine makes work easier
Presented the model clearly to the class

hints: Choose one type of simple machine.
